consentOverlay.title: About the pictures
consentOverlay.body1: When you finish a word, this app shows an image that matches it. We filter what we can so the experience stays appropriate for learning.
consentOverlay.body2: Automated filters are not perfect. If you need tighter control, open **Settings** any time for options like **Profanity filtering** and approved word lists.
consentOverlay.body3: Continuing means you are comfortable using the app with that in mind.

instructionsOverlay.title: CVI Type Talker

lines.typeLetters: Type letters to hear them spoken aloud.
lines.pressSpaceEnter: Press **Space** or **Enter** to hear the whole word and see a picture.
lines.pressArrows: Press **← →** arrow keys to flip through pictures of the same word.
lines.pressTeacherMode: Press **Ctrl+Shift+Y** to start Teacher Mode (student fills in a target word).
lines.pressTeacherPrompt: Press **Tab** or **?** in Teacher Mode to hear the next letter.

instructionsOverlay.keyboardNotice: ⌨️ This app requires a **physical keyboard**. It will not work on a touchscreen without one connected.
instructionsOverlay.screenReaderParagraph: The typing area is **not** a standard text field in the browser, so your screen reader may not read what you type the way it would in a normal text box. The app speaks each letter and word with built-in speech, and the status line at the bottom of the page announces many updates (including words you finish).

settingsGuideModal.title: ⚙️ Settings Guide
settingsGuideModal.intro: Here's a quick overview of everything you can customise:
settingsGuideModal.sectionTextAppearanceBody: Change the font style, size, and colour of the typing display, plus the background colour.
settingsGuideModal.sectionBubbleLettersBody: Add a coloured outline around every letter to make text pop against any background.
settingsGuideModal.sectionTypingControlBody: Set a minimum delay between key presses — helpful for students who press keys accidentally or too quickly.
settingsGuideModal.sectionImageDisplayBody: Control how large the picture appears. Pre-load images for specific words so they show instantly when typed.
settingsGuideModal.sectionImageFilteringBody: Block certain words from ever showing a picture, or restrict the app to an approved word list only.
settingsGuideModal.sectionImageNavArrowsBody: Show or hide the on-screen arrow buttons for flipping through multiple photos. The keyboard arrow keys always work too.
settingsGuideModal.sectionTeacherModeBody: Press **Ctrl+Shift+Y** to enter a target word for the student to fill in. Press **Tab** or **?** to hear an audio prompt for the next letter.
settingsGuideModal.sectionMouseCursorBody: Change the cursor style — useful if a student is using a mouse to click the navigation arrows.
settingsGuideModal.sectionSessionHistoryBody: A running log of every word typed this session with timestamps and typing speed (WPM/LPM). Past sessions are saved in your browser for teacher review.
settingsGuideModal.repeatFooter: Open Settings from the gear button to change options. You can reopen this guide anytime.

settingsPanel.screenReaderNote: The main typing area is not a standard text field, so your screen reader may not treat it like a normal text box. The app uses built-in speech for letters and words, and the status line at the bottom of the page announces many updates. The same information appears on the first screen when you open the app.

labelsAndControls.rateLimitNote: When off, every key goes through so students can explore freely. Turn this on to slow down very fast typing. The app may suggest enabling it if rapid typing produces nonsense words.
labelsAndControls.removeImageBackgroundNote: Uses AI to isolate the subject on a transparent background. Downloads a ~30MB model on first use (cached after).
labelsAndControls.preloadImagesNote: Images for these words will be fetched (and background-removed, if enabled) as soon as the session starts — so they appear instantly when the child types them. Separate words with commas.
labelsAndControls.customWordListEmptyWarning: Custom word list is empty — images will still show for other words until you add allowed words.
labelsAndControls.blockedWordsNote: These words will never show images, regardless of other settings.
labelsAndControls.customImagesIntroNote: Add your own pictures from this device for specific words. These are saved securely offline and take priority over Wikimedia pictures.
labelsAndControls.arrowsSectionNote: Arrows let you flip between multiple photos of the same word. You can also use the ← → arrow keys on the keyboard.
labelsAndControls.cursorSectionNote: Change the mouse cursor style. A large pointer can help children identify where to click to flip through pictures. Note: browsers limit cursor customization — for flipping pictures, the keyboard arrow keys (← →) always work regardless of cursor style.
labelsAndControls.sessionHistoryNote: All words typed this session, in order, with WPM and LPM at each word. This list is preserved here even if the student clears the screen.
labelsAndControls.historyLabel: Words typed this session, with timestamps and speed
labelsAndControls.historyTextareaPlaceholder: No words typed yet this session.
labelsAndControls.pastSessionsNote: Previous typing sessions saved in this browser. Select a session to review every word with its WPM and LPM.
labelsAndControls.pastSessionDetailPlaceholder: Select a session above to view its word history.
